from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-98662c3e.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter


def _mode(values):
    return Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if _mode(grid[r]) != 8]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if _mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) != 8]
    border = _mode([_mode(grid[r]) for r in row_lines])

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            v = grid[r0][c0]
            if v != border and v == grid[r0][c1] == grid[r1][c0] == grid[r1][c1]:
                row.append(v)
            else:
                row.append(8)
        out.append(row)

    active_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(out) if any(v != 8 for v in row)]
    active_cols = [c for c in range(len(out[0])) if any(out[r][c] != 8 for r in range(len(out)))]
    if not active_rows or not active_cols:
        return [[8]]
    return [row[active_cols[0]:active_cols[-1] + 1] for row in out[active_rows[0]:active_rows[-1] + 1]]
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p.read_text())
